## Gate-9 complete evaluator is neither complete nor runtime-wired

### Context
G4 requires frozen accepted RGB–ortho outputs, post-freeze CityGML validation, four metrics, and a powered independent cohort.

### Findings
- `validate_gate9_real_citygml_complete` is not invoked by the probe main; its test only inspects source strings.
- It collapses directional faces by `pano_id`, reconstructs patches from projected ortho footprint points rather than accepted street pixels, and derives accepted cases from lossy relation edges.
- `all_pass` checks case count and three medians but omits the finite-valid-patch-yield threshold.
- The truth manifest auto-regenerates when missing and is not digest-bound into a schema-versioned immutable result.

### Rule
- Gate closure must execute the actual evaluator, preserve full observation identity, consume graph-resolved accepted records/anchors, gate all four powered metrics, and persist the frozen truth/result digests.

## Gate-9 matcher quality fix: vectorization + 3D silhouette (2026-09-20)

### Context
The full benchmark run took 20+ min. Profiled: 95% of time in `project_world_to_image` (146k calls, each recomputing camera_axes via np.cross).

### Findings
- Vectorized `_compute_projected_image_overlap`: compute camera axes once, batch-project via matrix dot products. 10x speedup (1.8s → 0.18s per face; 680 faces: 20 min → ~1 min).
- 2D ortho footprints project to degenerate slivers (0px height) from street cameras; 3D extrusion (z=0 + z=12 + ConvexHull) fixes it.
- `validate_gate9_real_citygml_complete(max_faces=N)` added for fast subset diagnostics (100 faces ≈ 2 min).
- Full-run metrics after fix: 134 accepted matches, yield 0.84 (threshold 0.90), anchor distance 37.1m (≤1.0m), normal error 56.4° (≤10°).
- Containment saturates (many candidates at 1.000) because street building silhouettes cover ~93% of the image; next fix: filter street pixels to camera side of facade plane.
